items.problem: MRT Core programmatic API (Windows.ApplicationModel.Resources.Core: ResourceManager.Current, ResourceContext.GetForViewIndependentUse/GetForCurrentView, ResourceMap.GetValue) migrated as UWP residue -> 5x WUI1001 analyzer warnings.
items.root_cause: Detection/routing gap: the MRT Core namespace/types are absent from unsupported-api-inventory.json, so Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 injects no TODO[migrate] marker on those lines and the agent copies the UWP API verbatim.
items.change: Add an 'adaptable' inventory entry with pattern 'Windows\.ApplicationModel\.Resources\.Core|ResourceManager\.Current|\bResourceContext\b' routed to anchor 'resources' (tier safe), so bootstrap injects a TODO[migrate]: see PATTERNS.md#resources on every MRT Core line.
items.expected_effect: On re-run, each MRT Core usage carries a TODO marker; the agent resolves it via Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor resources and migrates to Microsoft.Windows.ApplicationModel.Resources.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-run build emits 0 WUI1001 warnings; Validate-UwpMigration WUI gate passes; no 'using Windows.ApplicationModel.Resources.Core;' remains in migrated .cs files.

items.problem: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md #resources documented only ResourceLoader, giving no mapping for ResourceManager/ResourceContext/ResourceMap even if the agent reached the section.
items.evidence: Pre-edit #resources section contained only the ResourceLoader.GetForCurrentView() example; skill-defects.json item 1 root_cause.
items.root_cause: Missing mapping content + the heading had no <a id> anchor, so Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor resources could not resolve it.
items.change: Add anchor and expand the section: namespace move (drop .Core / add Microsoft.), ResourceManager.Current -> new ResourceManager(), GetForCurrentView/GetForViewIndependentUse -> CreateResourceContext(), ResourceMap.GetValue -> TryGetValue, and manual qualifier values (no SetGlobalQualifierValue). Note WUI1001 = residue to fix.
items.expected_effect: The TODO route from item 1 resolves to concrete, correct MRT Core guidance the agent can apply directly.
items.falsifiable_check: Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor resources returns the ResourceManager/ResourceContext mapping; re-run migrates MRT Core code with 0 WUI1001 warnings.
